tests: Prompt and whoami use the current profile name
Quoted paths, quoted literal operators and unquoted redirection tokenize correctly
Help lists every supported command and reset confirmation
Relative, home, parent and previous directory navigation works
Touch preserves data; redirect confirms overwrite; append and cat use real drive contents
Missing parents, existing folders and file/directory mismatches produce realistic errors
Unknown commands, bad options, unmatched quotes and invalid redirection fail cleanly
Binary data and huge files are not dumped into the Terminal
ls, dir, long/hidden listings and tree reflect existing virtual files
Shell treats markup as text and never evaluates commands
All four themes persist without changing desktop preferences
Tab completion handles commands, quoted folders, themes, unmatched prefixes and cursor suffixes
Up/down history restores drafts and survives reopening
Date and coloured neofetch use actual runtime information
null.user does nothing without explicit confirmation and rejects argument bypasses
History and output clearing remain bounded and drive writes refresh Files
